recent_posts.title: How to Check If Your WordPress SEO Is Actually Working
recent_posts.summary: A beginner-friendly guide to verifying whether WordPress SEO efforts are producing results. Covers five key signals to monitor: organic traffic growth (via MonsterInsights and Google Analytics), page indexing status (via AIOSEO and Google Search Console), keyword rankings, click-through rate (CTR), and SEO-driven conversions. Includes practical steps for each check, tips for fixing common issues like unindexed pages or low CTR, a simple monthly SEO checklist, and realistic timelines for when SEO results typically appear.

recent_posts.title: Universally is an AI-powered WordPress site translation platform
recent_posts.summary: Syed Balkhi, founder of WPBeginner, announces Universally, an AI-powered website translation platform he built after struggling with existing WordPress translation plugins. Traditional plugins caused database bloat and admin slowdowns, while SaaS alternatives were prohibitively expensive. Universally stores translations in the cloud and delivers them via edge servers, avoiding performance hits. It supports 70+ languages, handles multilingual SEO automatically (hreflang tags, translated meta tags, XML sitemaps, RTL support), includes an AI glossary for brand term protection, and auto-updates translations when content changes. A free plan offers 1 site, 1 language, and 2,000 words/month; paid plans start at $7.50/month. The platform works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, and other platforms.

recent_posts.title: How to migrate from Contact Form 7 to WPForms after the feature freeze
recent_posts.summary: Contact Form 7 creator Takayuki Miyoshi announced at WordCamp Asia 2026 that version 6.2 will be the plugin's final major release, entering a feature freeze with only security patches going forward. The successor project Contactable.io isn't expected until 2028. A step-by-step migration guide walks WordPress users through switching to WPForms using its built-in Contact Form 7 importer, covering installation, running the import wizard, reviewing migrated forms, replacing old shortcodes/blocks, testing submissions, and finally deactivating Contact Form 7. The free WPForms Lite version includes the importer and drag-and-drop builder, making migration accessible without cost.

recent_posts.title: WPVibe Brings AI to WordPress + Smarter Automations, SEO, & Fundraising Tools
recent_posts.summary: Monthly WordPress news roundup covering WPVibe, a new MCP-based plugin that lets you manage your WordPress site through AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT via natural conversation. Also covered: AIOSEO 4.9.6 with AI Schema Generator and bulk SEO actions, Charitable's Recurring Donations 2.0, Uncanny Automator 7.2 adding Microsoft Teams and LinkedIn integrations, PushEngage's visual workflow builder, OptinMonster's per-device popup styling, WPConsent 1.1.4 privacy automation upgrades, Contact Form 7 entering feature freeze, WordCamp Asia 2026 recap in Mumbai, and Cloudflare's Em Dash CMS announcement.

recent_posts.title: 9 WordPress themes for consulting websites tested and ranked
recent_posts.summary: A curated roundup of 9 WordPress themes suited for consulting websites, based on hands-on testing of 20+ options. Top picks include Sydney (best overall, strong free tier), SeedProd (AI-powered site generation in under 60 seconds), and Divi (best for agencies needing creative control). Each theme is evaluated on setup speed, starter site quality, page builder compatibility, customization depth, mobile responsiveness, and performance. The guide maps each theme to a specific consulting profile, from solo practitioners to multi-client agencies.

recent_posts.title: How to diagnose and fix a WordPress traffic drop
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step troubleshooting guide for diagnosing and recovering from WordPress traffic drops. Covers seven key steps: confirming the drop via analytics, checking for Google manual actions in Search Console, identifying algorithm update impacts using AIOSEO, auditing technical errors like blocked indexing or broken redirects, verifying crawl budget and indexing status, scanning for malware and SEO spam injections, and monitoring recovery using site notes in MonsterInsights.

recent_posts.title: How to Sell on ChatGPT with WooCommerce (Agentic Guide)
recent_posts.summary: ChatGPT now supports product discovery directly in chat, letting users find and click through to buy from registered merchants. This guide walks WooCommerce store owners through the full process: applying as an OpenAI merchant, adding GTIN or MPN product identifiers, installing the Product Feed Pro by AdTribes plugin, generating an OpenAI-compatible JSONL product feed, and submitting it for validation. The program is currently live for U.S. merchants, with global expansion underway. Customers complete purchases on the merchant's own WooCommerce store, preserving the customer relationship and enabling upsells.

recent_posts.title: How to Build a WooCommerce Sales Funnel That Converts
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide to building a WooCommerce sales funnel without coding. Covers all five stages: creating a high-converting landing page with SeedProd, capturing leads with OptinMonster, adding upsells and downsells using the Merchant plugin, optimizing checkout (guest checkout, trust badges, minimal form fields, multiple payment options), and setting up post-purchase email sequences with FunnelKit Automations. Also includes guidance on measuring funnel performance, A/B testing strategies, and a 30-day post-launch optimization plan.

recent_posts.title: How to build a product recommendation quiz in WordPress
recent_posts.summary: Step-by-step guide to building a product recommendation quiz in WordPress using two methods: WPForms Pro with Constant Contact integration, and Thrive Quiz Builder. Covers setting up quiz outcome pages, conditional logic for personalized results, email list segmentation based on quiz answers, opt-in gates for lead capture, multi-page form setup, follow-up email automation, and embedding the quiz on a WordPress site.

recent_posts.title: Fewer Returns, More Sales: How to Add Size Charts in WooCommerce
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide covering three methods to add size charts to WooCommerce product pages: using the free WPC Product Size Chart plugin, the premium Advanced Product Size Charts Pro plugin, and the SeedProd page builder for full design control. Each method is explained with setup instructions, assignment to product categories, and popup configuration. The guide also covers what data to include in size charts, mobile considerations, and bonus tools for store optimization like analytics and cart abandonment reduction.
